title: IMPORTANT NOTICE REGARDING CRC RECRUITMENT
message: NOTICE: All previous CRC recruitment advertisements and related corrigenda stand cancelled. A fresh Advertisement No. 2, CEO Doda/2026, dated 10-10-2026, has been issued. All previously applied and interested candidates are requested to apply afresh through the Google Form link provided. Last date to apply is 15-10-2026
